objective: Improve pooled weighted training OOF MAE over the best known guard-eligible model, without worsening the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard. Choose the next informative untried experiment autonomously until the authorized minimum is met.
scope: Continuing development on previously observed training folds. No validation/scoring endpoint.

continuation_policy.stop_policy: Before the required total, model/stagnation stops are deferred. Failed and duplicate attempts do not count. Operator stop and resource limits always apply. The previous run stop does not end this authorized continuation.

training_workbench.feedback_scope: Original training fixed-group OOF only; adaptive development feedback

guard.rule: Positive-Tc OOF MAE must not exceed this same best-overall shared global anchor

baseline_G01.feedback_scope: Original training fixed-group OOF only; adaptive development feedback

training_workbench.interpretation: All metrics are adaptively reused training OOF. Improvements here need a separately designed future evaluation.
training_workbench.routing_caveat: Composition partitions are operational rules, not verified physical families. KMeans centroid-ordered cluster identities may shift between folds.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: A05 is the best guard-eligible configuration, while A01 shows that a route-specific extra_trees/raw fe_anion expert worsens performance and L001 shows that a broad hist_gradient_boosting/raw fallback also worsens performance. The remaining focused test is whether hist_gradient_boosting/raw helps only when specialized to the 285-row, 37-group fe_anion route, while preserving A05's extra_trees/raw behavior for cu_o and other.

reflection.summary: L002 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.5449 K <= 8.8322 K), but it did not improve the A05 incumbent. Pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.8018 K versus 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.0492 K. Relative to A05, positive-Tc MAE worsened from 8.5051 K to 8.5449 K and reported-zero MAE worsened from 6.0806 K to 6.1508 K. High-Tc MAE improved slightly from 28.8502 K to 28.7654 K, showing a subgroup tradeoff rather than an eligible pooled win. On fe_anion specifically, hist_gradient_boosting/raw improved positive-Tc and high-Tc errors but worsened overall and reported-zero errors; the latter costs outweighed the gains. Thus neither a specialized hist_gradient_boosting/raw fe_anion expert nor the previously tested broad hist-gradient fallback improves A05.
reflection.next_focus: Retain A05 as the best guard-eligible development configuration: composition input, chemistry routing, extra_trees/raw global model, and extra_trees/raw experts for cu_o and other with fe_anion falling back globally. Any future work should evaluate A05 on a separately designed holdout or new data and, if development resumes, focus on richer ways to resolve the persistent cu_o zero-versus-high-Tc ambiguity rather than further combinations from this exhausted fixed menu.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: A05’s chemistry routing may make the repaired composition representation more useful than it was in the global G05 test by allowing separate extra_trees/raw fits for cu_o and other while retaining broad fallback training for the small fe_anion route. G05 was only 0.0685 K worse than G01 globally, so an exact input-only ablation of A05 is informative and avoids confounding the representation with the mixed models and targets used in C03.

reflection.summary: L003 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.7105 K <= 8.8322 K), but it was not an eligible improvement. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 8.0061 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.2535 K and far from the required 0.01 K gain. Relative to A05, reported-zero MAE worsened from 6.0806 K to 6.4411 K, positive-Tc MAE worsened from 8.5051 K to 8.7105 K, and high-Tc MAE worsened from 28.8502 K to 29.6487 K. The repaired input therefore harmed every reported subgroup in this controlled A05 input ablation, despite remaining guard-eligible. Counterexamples also confirm the persistent cu_o ambiguity: some reported-zero cuprates were overpredicted by more than 72 K, while high-Tc cuprates were underpredicted by roughly 67–70 K.
reflection.next_focus: Because the required continuation minimum remains pending, test an untried component ablation of A05 using composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, and only a cu_o extra_trees/raw expert, with both fe_anion and other falling back to the global model. This isolates whether A05's improvement is primarily supplied by its cu_o specialization or requires the separate other-route fit. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K; subgroup changes remain tradeoffs rather than substitutes for those criteria.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: A05’s gain over the global G01 model may be driven mainly by the cu_o-specific extra_trees/raw fit, while its separate other-route fit may be unnecessary or mildly harmful. This untried component ablation retains A05’s cu_o expert but lets both fe_anion and other use the global extra_trees/raw model, directly isolating the contribution of other-route specialization after L003 showed that changing the input representation worsened every reported subgroup.

reflection.summary: L004 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.5017 K <= 8.8322 K), but it was not an eligible improvement. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.8380 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.0854 K rather than the required gain of at least 0.01 K. Relative to A05, reported-zero MAE worsened from 6.0806 K to 6.3634 K, while positive-Tc MAE improved marginally from 8.5051 K to 8.5017 K and high-Tc MAE was unchanged at 28.8502 K. Thus, retaining only the cu_o expert produces a subgroup tradeoff and shows that A05's pooled advantage requires the other-route specialization or its combination with cu_o; it is not explained by cu_o specialization alone.
reflection.next_focus: Because the continuation minimum remains pending, run the complementary untried A05 ablation: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, and only an other-route extra_trees/raw expert, with cu_o and fe_anion falling back globally. Comparing this directly with G01, L004, and A05 will isolate whether the large other partition supplies A05's improvement by itself or whether the cu_o and other experts interact additively. The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement if pooled weighted OOF MAE is not below 7.742598770753422 K or positive-Tc MAE exceeds 8.832165507919859 K; subgroup gains without both conditions remain tradeoffs.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: A05’s pooled improvement over G01 may be supplied largely by specializing the large other route, while the cu_o expert may mainly shift errors between reported-zero and positive-Tc cases. The complementary ablation to L004—retaining only an extra_trees/raw other expert and allowing cu_o and fe_anion to fall back to the global extra_trees/raw model—will isolate the contribution of other-route specialization. L004 remained guard-eligible but worsened pooled MAE by 0.0854 K, despite a marginal positive-Tc gain, showing that cu_o specialization alone is insufficient.

reflection.summary: L005 executed successfully and improved pooled OOF MAE over G01, but it is not guard-eligible and did not improve A05. Its positive-Tc MAE was 8.8356 K, exceeding the fixed 8.8322 K guard by 0.0034 K, while pooled MAE was 7.8272 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.0746 K rather than the required 0.01 K gain. Relative to A05, reported-zero MAE improved from 6.0806 K to 5.5868 K, but positive-Tc MAE worsened from 8.5051 K to 8.8356 K and high-Tc MAE worsened from 28.8502 K to 32.7716 K. Thus, other-route specialization alone creates a zero-versus-positive tradeoff and fails the deterministic guard; combined with L004, the ablations show that A05's advantage requires joint cu_o and other specialization.
reflection.next_focus: Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test an untried target-only perturbation of A05: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o extra_trees/raw, and other extra_trees/log1p, with fe_anion falling back globally. L005 shows that the large other expert materially improves reported-zero error, while global log1p results show a strong tendency to favor zeros at the expense of positives; restricting log1p to the low-temperature other route tests whether that asymmetry can reduce pooled error without disturbing A05's cu_o high-Tc behavior. The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: L005 shows that specializing the large other route with extra_trees/raw strongly reduces reported-zero MAE but sacrifices positive- and high-Tc accuracy, while global log1p experiments show an even stronger zero-favoring asymmetry. Applying log1p only to A05's other expert is an informative target-only perturbation: it tests whether additional low-temperature robustness in the other partition can lower pooled MAE while preserving the successful cu_o extra_trees/raw expert and broad extra_trees/raw fallback for fe_anion.

reflection.summary: L006 executed successfully but was not an eligible improvement. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.8837 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.1312 K rather than the required gain of at least 0.01 K. It also failed the deterministic positive-Tc guard: 8.8646 K exceeded the G01 anchor of 8.8322 K by 0.0324 K. Relative to A05, reported-zero MAE improved from 6.0806 K to 5.7044 K, but positive-Tc MAE worsened from 8.5051 K to 8.8646 K, while high-Tc MAE was unchanged at 28.8502 K because the cu_o expert was unchanged. Thus, applying log1p only to the other expert intensified the expected zero-versus-positive tradeoff and cannot be called a guard-eligible win. The large opposing cu_o errors also persist, with reported-zero cases overpredicted by roughly 67–69 K and high-Tc cases underpredicted by roughly 61–65 K.
reflection.next_focus: Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test an untried model-only perturbation of A05: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o extra_trees/raw, and other hist_gradient_boosting/raw, with fe_anion falling back globally. L006 rejects target compression for the other route, but does not determine whether a different raw-target estimator can improve its fit. This configuration preserves A05's cu_o and fe_anion behavior while isolating the estimator used for the large other partition. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE is at most 8.832165507919859 K; subgroup improvements alone remain tradeoffs.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: A05 remains the best guard-eligible configuration, while L006 showed that changing the large other route from extra_trees/raw to extra_trees/log1p worsens pooled and positive-Tc MAE and fails the guard. A model-only perturbation using hist_gradient_boosting/raw for the other route will test whether a different estimator can improve that large partition without the harmful target compression, while preserving A05's cu_o extra_trees/raw expert and extra_trees/raw fallback for fe_anion.

reflection.summary: L007 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.4615 K <= 8.8322 K), but it was not an eligible improvement. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.7612 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.0086 K; an eligible gain required MAE below 7.7426 K. Relative to A05, positive-Tc MAE improved from 8.5051 K to 8.4615 K, but reported-zero MAE worsened from 6.0806 K to 6.2051 K, while high-Tc MAE was unchanged at 28.8502 K because the cu_o expert was unchanged. Thus, hist_gradient_boosting/raw on the other route produced a near-incumbent subgroup tradeoff, not a guard-eligible pooled win.
reflection.next_focus: Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test an untried model-only perturbation of A05 on the problematic cu_o route: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o hist_gradient_boosting/raw, and other extra_trees/raw, with fe_anion falling back globally. A04 suggests that hist_gradient_boosting/raw for cu_o can improve positive- and high-Tc errors while worsening reported-zero error, but A04 confounded that change with a separately fitted fe_anion expert. This focused configuration isolates the cu_o estimator while preserving A05's successful other expert and fe_anion fallback. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K; subgroup gains without both conditions remain tradeoffs.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: A05 remains the best guard-eligible configuration. L007 showed that hist_gradient_boosting/raw on the large other route trades better positive-Tc MAE for worse reported-zero MAE and slightly worse pooled MAE. The complementary focused test is to use hist_gradient_boosting/raw only for cu_o while preserving A05's extra_trees/raw other expert and broad extra_trees/raw fallback for fe_anion. A04 suggests this cu_o estimator can improve positive- and high-Tc errors, but A04 confounded it with a separate fe_anion expert; omitting that expert isolates the cu_o change.

reflection.summary: L008 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.3382 K <= 8.8322 K), but it was not an eligible improvement. Pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.9577 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.2051 K rather than the required gain of at least 0.01 K. Relative to A05, positive-Tc MAE improved from 8.5051 K to 8.3382 K and high-Tc MAE improved from 28.8502 K to 27.8571 K, but reported-zero MAE worsened sharply from 6.0806 K to 7.1123 K. The cu_o counterexamples confirm this tradeoff, including zero-Tc materials overpredicted by roughly 97–107 K and high-Tc materials underpredicted by up to 72.6 K. Thus the cu_o hist_gradient_boosting/raw expert improves positive and high-Tc behavior but its zero-Tc cost prevents a pooled win.
reflection.next_focus: Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test the untried target-only follow-up to L008: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o hist_gradient_boosting/log1p, and other extra_trees/raw, with fe_anion falling back globally. L008 showed that hist_gradient_boosting/raw on cu_o substantially overpredicts reported zeros while improving positive and high-Tc MAE; restricting target compression to this route tests whether it can reduce those extreme zero errors enough to offset the expected loss on positive and high-Tc cases. The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K.

recent_cycles.hypothesis: L008 showed that using hist_gradient_boosting/raw only for cu_o improved positive-Tc MAE from 8.5051 K to 8.3382 K and high-Tc MAE from 28.8502 K to 27.8571 K, but sharply worsened reported-zero MAE from 6.0806 K to 7.1123 K and therefore worsened pooled MAE. Changing only that cu_o expert to hist_gradient_boosting/log1p may suppress its extreme overprediction of reported-zero cuprates enough to improve pooled MAE, while retaining A05's extra_trees/raw other expert and fe_anion fallback.

reflection.summary: L009 executed successfully but failed both eligibility criteria. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 8.5585 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.8059 K rather than the required gain of at least 0.01 K. Its positive-Tc MAE was 11.0373 K, exceeding the fixed G01 guard of 8.8322 K by 2.2051 K, so it cannot be called an eligible win. Relative to A05, reported-zero MAE improved sharply from 6.0806 K to 3.0508 K, but positive-Tc MAE worsened from 8.5051 K to 11.0373 K and high-Tc MAE from 28.8502 K to 48.9755 K. On cu_o specifically, log1p produced severe underprediction: positive-Tc MAE was 40.5124 K and high-Tc MAE was 54.8772 K, with several 92.8–95 K materials predicted near 4.6–6.2 K. Thus target compression reduced zero overprediction but catastrophically amplified the zero-versus-high-Tc tradeoff.
reflection.next_focus: Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test an untried target-only fe_anion specialization around A05: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o extra_trees/raw, other extra_trees/raw, and fe_anion extra_trees/log1p. A01 showed that a route-specific extra_trees/raw fe_anion expert worsened A05, while L002 showed the same for hist_gradient_boosting/raw; this isolates whether target compression helps the smaller fe_anion route, where L009's unchanged fallback had reported-zero MAE of 11.2752 K, without disturbing A05's cu_o or other predictions. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K. Any reduction in reported-zero error that violates either condition is only a subgroup tradeoff.

limitations: All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.
L009 failed the deterministic positive-Tc guard and the pooled improvement threshold.
Chemistry routes are operational composition partitions rather than verified physical material families.
The cu_o route has only 66 groups and exhibits severe zero-versus-high-Tc ambiguity.
Many allowed configurations remain untried; the evidence does not establish generalization or identify new superconductors.
